name: Ammo at the most
author: OpenRAC contributors
description: At the Gadgetron vendor, buying ammo starts at the most you can buy (the rounds the weapon has room for, or as many as your bolts pay for) instead of 1. Down still lowers it, Up raises it again, Square buys as before.

settings.name: Trace
settings.description: For bug reports: a line in the game's log each time the count is set (the weapon, its ammo, the bolts and the price).
